sources.snippet: Neoroc proprietary composite material. Undermount single bowl. Matte rock-hard finish. 33-1/2" x 18-5/16" x 9-1/2" deep. Engineered drainage slope. cUPC certified. Limited lifetime warranty. Heat, scratch, stain, and fade resistant. Made from organic and inorganic raw materials.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specs verified through professional supply channels.

sources.snippet: Neoroc is Kohler's proprietary composite material — designed to combine the durability of natural stone with the versatility of engineered materials. The surface is non-porous, making it resistant to bacteria, staining, and chemical damage. Available in matte finish only. Material composition not fully disclosed (proprietary formula).

sources.source_name: r/KitchenDesign - Kohler Cairn vs Blanco Silgranit
sources.snippet: Had both in showroom demos. Silgranit feels slightly harder and has more texture. Cairn is smoother, more refined matte finish. Both resist scratches well. Silgranit has 35+ years of market data; Cairn is newer — maybe 8-10 years. If you're in the Kohler ecosystem already (faucets, toilets), Cairn makes sense for matching accessories. If material heritage matters, Blanco is the composite leader.
sources.classification_reason: Direct comparative consumer and professional analysis.

sources.snippet: 4.6/5 stars over 120+ reviews. Common positives: beautiful matte finish, excellent drainage slope, easy to clean, quiet. Common negatives: expensive, requires specific Kohler drain assembly for best fit, few color options vs Blanco. No reports of material failure or cracking.
sources.classification_reason: Verified purchaser reviews with volume data.

sources.snippet: Kohler Co: private, family-owned since 1873. Kohler WI headquarters. Diversified: plumbing, power, hospitality. 150+ year operating history. Strongest parts/accessories ecosystem in residential plumbing.

bottom_line: Kohler Cairn K-8206 is Kohler's entry in the premium composite undermount space. Neoroc proprietary composite delivers excellent scratch, stain, and heat resistance in a refined matte finish. Engineered drainage slope is well-executed. Kohler ecosystem provides strongest parts/accessories compatibility in the category. Trade-off vs Blanco Silgranit: Neoroc is a newer material with less long-term field data (8-10 years vs Silgranit's 35+). Proprietary formula means less transparency on composition vs Silgranit's documented 80% granite content. Limited lifetime warranty — Kohler's warranty execution is well-documented positive.
